messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated error rate on /v1/generate for model=redwood-rlhf-v2 (us-east-1). Alert level: P2. Errors: invalid token id / garbled token sequence. Started ~10:02 UTC. logs: https://internal.logs/runs/ab12c3
anya: seeing it too — canary traffic is affected, not full prod yet. spikes in decoding errors at step ~45
devon: pushed weightset w/ ensemble reorder at 10:01 UTC, flag 'serve-new-weights' enabled for canary at 10:02. correlates with timeframe
samira: oncall here, assigning. devon can you share the weightset id and tokenizer bundle id that went out?
devon: weightset=ws-2026-04-11-enc-shuffle-7, tokenizer=vocab-2026-04-09-icu. quick tail of log:
```
2026-04-11T10:03:12Z ERROR decode: token_id out_of_range at position 43 (id 502345)
2026-04-11T10:03:12Z INFO kv-cache flush
2026-04-11T10:03:13Z WARN generation: odd token map length, expected 50257 got 50260
```
anya: that token count mismatch screams vocab/index alignment. maybe tokenizer bundle doesn't match weights (vocab ids shifted)
leo: tagging product — any customer-facing errors? support pings?
devon: Support reported ~8 customers with short garbled completions, roughly 120 failed/garbled requests across canary slice (12m window). No escalations yet.
feature-flag-bot: serve-new-weights: toggled -> true (canary). Knob owner: infra/deploy
samira: let's flip the kill-switch now for canary and pause rollout. @devon, flip `serve-new-weights` -> false, and remove canary traffic until we validate bundle mapping.
devon: doing it now. feature-flag-bot: serve-new-weights: toggled -> false :white_check_mark:
opsbot: routing: rolling traffic away from weightset ws-2026-04-11-enc-shuffle-7; canary slice drained over 30s
anya: metrics: error rate down from 7.2% to 0.4% in canary after flag flip; still watching for residuals
samira: good. plan: 1) rollback canary weightset to previous ws-2026-03-30-stable-3 2) run validation job to compare tokenizer map 3) if mismatch confirmed, block artifact promotion and open release rollback ticket
devon: initiating rollback to ws-2026-03-30-stable-3 now. deploy-bot: rollback request received - artifact ws-2026-03-30-stable-3 -> promoting to canary (id: roll-8771)
deploy-bot: canary promotion complete. traffic cutover done (10:08 UTC).
opsbot: perf snapshot: error rate back to baseline (0.12%) within 90s of cutover. latency stable.
leo: noting customer impact: short garbled completions for ~8 customers, no PII exposed per initial logs. advising support to send an FYI and offer retry/comp credits if they saw material impact
anya: confirmed tokenizer bundle vs weights mapping mismatch — tokenizer had vocabulary padded with 3 extra tokens in the new bundle. mismatch introduced during vocabulary merge step in packaging pipeline. failing unit: pkg/tokenizer/merge_v1 -> off-by-3 index offset
samira: escalation notes: postmortem ticket INC-2026-449 opened. initial severity P2 -> will evaluate if severity needs to increase. owners: devon (deploy), anya (runtime), samira (oncall lead)
devon: adding immediate remediation: pin release pipeline to validate vocab length==weights.vocab_size in CI and add a canary validation job comparing top-1k token lookups. I'll open a PR in infra/deploy: https://code.redwood/repo/infra/merge/PR-452
anya: nice. follow-on: run a sweep to ensure no other in-flight artifacts used same packaging path.
samira: handing off to next oncall shift @leo for follow-up and postmortem. I'll leave the channel but will monitor the ticket. :hand:
leo: taking it, will coordinate postmortem and customer comms. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-449 created. Pager history attached. severity=P2. assignees=[devon, anya, samira]"
